messages:
tay: Heads-up from our SI partner. They want an official pattern for certificate rotation for the OTLP collector running on air-gapped HW bundles. The ask: offline signing workflow, rotation TTL guidance, and a revocation path that works without outbound access. Can we draft this and include a marketplace-approved README?

nina: Good catch. Key pieces: 1) cert provisioning via signed CSR shipped on USB or transferred via ops, 2) local cert store path and watcher in collector container, 3) a shortscript for atomic rotate (write new cert, liveness check, swap), 4) clear rollback steps. TTL: recommend 90 days by default, allow customer override to 365.

prashant: I'll prototype a rotate.sh that validates private key permissions and does a graceful SIGHUP to collector process. Will add a checksum verification step. I'll open a PR in infra-extras. Link once ready.

lisa: Marketplace docs must include privacy/retention blurb. For traces we mark APM as opt-in and require explicit consent flag in config: telemetry.enable_traces = false by default. Metrics (host/gpu) are OK to enable by default but must be redactable. Also legal wants examples of non-PII labels and hashing guidance for user ids.

dd-integ-bot: Datadog partner guide updated: offline-cert-patterns v1.2. See internal: https://internal.datadog/partners/ri-offline-cert. Added mapping for datadog tags and recommended span prefixes.

tay: For revocation we can support a local CRL file and a signed revocation manifest that the operator places in /etc/telemetry/revocations.json; collector will check the manifest at startup and at rotation. Add note: if using file exporter + partner ingestion, ingestion job should ignore revoked certs.

nina: Sample collector config snippet (for README) — minimal, with consent flag note:
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
      http: {}
processors:
  resource:
    attributes:
      - key: service.name
        value: "redwood-hw-agent"
      - key: hw.vendor
        value: ${HW_VENDOR}
      - key: hw.model
        value: ${HW_MODEL}
exporters:
  file:
    path: /var/log/telemetry/otlp-out.json
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [resource]
      exporters: [file]
# traces disabled unless telemetry.enable_traces = true in /etc/telemetry/config.yaml
```
Include comment: datadog exporter block removed in air-gapped bundles; partner ingestion pulls from file export via signed transfer.

prashant: Test plan: 1) simulate offline rotate: generate CSR on sim-node, sign via offline CA, apply cert, ensure collector reloads without dropping in-flight spans; 2) inject revoked manifest and verify collector refuses revoked cert; 3) run perf smoke to ensure no extra latency. I'll run this Tuesday 09:30 PT on sim-hw and post artifacts.

lisa: Dashboard tile pack: I'll prepare two tiles (gpu_util and token_throughput) and a trace tile (inference.request waterfall) that maps to the local file ingestion schema. Add metadata: partner:datadog, distribution:marketplace-appliance, privacy:airgap-safe.

ci-bot: ci-bot: Simulation job queued: infra/sim-rotate-run-12. Logs will appear at https://ci.redwood/run/12/logs once complete.

tay: Action items recap: @prashant rotate.sh + tests (Tues 9:30), @nina README + cert pattern doc (PR by EOD Mon), @lisa dashboard tiles + privacy blurb (EOW). Legal to provide final telemetry wording. We'll bundle docs into marketplace listing and call the launch "Signed-Collector Airgap". Everyone ok?

nina: Ok for me. I'll include example wording for telemetry.enable_traces and a short operator checklist for onboarding.

prashant: Roger. Will push artifacts to the thread after the run. :thumbsup:

lisa: I'll coordinate with partner marketing on a joint datasheet after legal signs off.

tay: Great. Keep updates here.
